The sentence currently claims a broader decomposition than that design identifies.

Leave the independent contribution of event timing unassessed, or reserve a separately authorized timing comparison on a common calendar evaluation population with explicit coverage/abstention handling. Do not add that experiment to the initial scope automatically.
